prompt: Create ONE production food-photography texture atlas for the EatWise nutrition app. This is an asset sprite sheet, NOT a UI mockup. EXACT grid: FIVE columns by FOUR rows, twenty equal, perfectly aligned rectangular cells edge-to-edge, ideally 1500 by 1200 pixels so cells are square. Match the reference's calm sage green backgrounds, overhead studio food photography, realistic textures, cream ceramic dishes, soft upper-left daylight and gentle shadows. Each food fully centered with generous 12% safe margin so every crop can independently fill a square app thumbnail. NO text, labels, borders, separators, gradients, collage overlaps, utensils, extra garnish, tablecloths, packaging or branding. One food subject per cell. Camera looking straight down; exact row-major order (left to right): ROW 1: plain dry rolled oat flakes in a shallow cream bowl; cooked brown rice in a cream bowl; two slices of whole-wheat bread on a small cream plate; a baked white potato with skin split open on a cream plate; cooked red kidney beans in a cream bowl. ROW 2: cooked black beans in a cream bowl; boiled green peas in a cream bowl; cooked shelled green edamame in a cream bowl; plain roasted turkey breast slices on a cream plate; drained canned tuna flakes on a cream plate. ROW 3: plain low-fat cottage cheese in a cream bowl; smooth peanut butter in a small cream bowl; walnut halves in a cream bowl; roasted green pumpkin seed kernels (pepitas) in a cream bowl; dry tiny black-and-white chia seeds in a cream bowl. ROW 4: brown flaxseeds in a cream bowl; fresh orange and orange wedges; fresh whole strawberries with leaves in a cream bowl; plain boiled carrot rounds in a cream bowl; plain boiled cauliflower florets in a cream bowl. All dishes and subjects remain strictly inside their grid cells. Reference is STYLE ONLY; do not repeat the foods in the reference. Produce this single twenty-cell atlas cleanly framed with consistent cells.
